 


## Incipit

Buffalo 27th Nov, 1859

 

My Old Brother

 

I have nothing especial to write but as I have just written a letter to my long brother at Washington, I thought to write you one, although you owe me two -- this will make three -- I excuse you because of the trouble & perplexities of building, finishing & getting into a new hous is something of a jobb as I know by experience -- they call me a fool for building this house sometime s-- hell I do not mind it much & sometimes they call me an old fool that I dont care for as I know of a great deal, but I do object to being called an old damned fool as that is rubbing it on to thick
